rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for Australia’s remote, arid inland regions.

example.english: I hear the outback is so hot in the daytime that you can't stand walking for ten minutes.
example.traditional: 聽講澳洲內陸日頭熱到行十分鐘都頂唔順。
